notes: Portable C++ and Java parity for the independently green native 226-assertion pending-NMRA timestamped attribute-update save/restore case. Three joined members are time constrained and two regulate with epsilon lookahead. An object is registered and discovered, the publisher changes its attribute default order to Timestamp, and the receiver issues NMRA(10) before accepting a timestamp-5 Update Attribute Values. The two regulators advance to time 4, making GALT equal 5; an untimed save captures the pre-grant queued update. After all members advance to 9 and restore, Reflect Attribute Values repeats the same object, producing federate, timestamp, order, tag, attribute payload, and retraction presence between Federation Restored and receiver TAG(5). Both callback models are exercised. The adapter supplies the provider, endpoint, logical-time implementation, callback model, class and attribute names, and IEEE 1516.2-2025 FOM with nonRegulatedGrant. Twenty-one direct requirement-section pairs cover thirteen clauses. The native and isolated portable C++ primary/contract passed against the installed package under both callback models and integer64/float64 time. Java compiles against the official API-only JAR; Java provider runtime, other timestamped producer families, general temporal persistence, interoperability, and conformance remain unverified.
